text: Hm? What is it?
Yes? How can I help?
Don't bother me, all right?
Hmph.
Do you need something from me?
I've got work to do. Make it quick.
What are you poking me for?
Good day to you too.
At this hour? Let me sleep.
Morning. Up already?
Heh-heh... hello!
What? Me? Heh-heh-heh.
I really ought to find myself a trade.
Trade? With what? I've got nothing.
Please... leave me be, I'm not well.
Hrrm.
Hmmm-hm?
Ee-uuh.
Ehh?
Ehh-uh.
Nahh.
Urrgh.
Hmph-hm.
Uuungh.
Huh? ...huh.
Nnn-yeah.
Mrrm. Mrrm-mrrm.
Hurrmph.
Mmmh-hm!
Grmbl... hmm.
Heh-heh. Heh!
Blub? ...Heh-heh-heh.
Yes, yes, I've seen you.
Always with the poking.
What now?
I'd like some peace, if you don't mind.
Visitors at this hour? Fine, then.
An offer you can't refuse? ...Sorry, fresh out of those.
Yes? I'm listening.
Out with it, I haven't got all day.
Oh! You startled me.
Mind your distance, please.
I've nothing for you. Sorry.
Are you buying, or just talking?
Hands off, thank you.
What? Have I got something on my face?
Mm-hm. And?
You again.
Let's both stay civil, shall we?
I'm busy. Can't you tell?
Good day, good day. And now?
Hm. You're still here.
Poke me again and I'll poke back. Eventually.
Just say it. I'm patient. Usually.
Are you sure you mean me?
All right, all right. I heard you.
Right in the middle of the day? I'm needed elsewhere.
My eyes are barely open and here you are.
I was just off to bed.
In this rain? Let's keep it short.
I'm not talking through that thunder. Get inside.
Down here? Keep your voice down.
Get me out of here and then we'll talk!
Take me away from here. Please.
Hit me first, talk after? No.
Not now... my head's spinning.
Too cold for conversation.
In this heat? Say your piece.
Heh-heh. You're funny.
I don't know anything. But I'll say it gladly.
Heh? Want to trade? I've got a stick.
I've got no trade. Nothing to barter with.
Ask me again when I've found a workstation.
I'd love to help. I just can't do anything.
Hmm-hmm-hmm.
Ehhm... heh.
Hrmph-nnh.
Uh-hmm.
Nnnh.
Heh-hmm?
Mmph.
Ahhrm.
Hnnn... hm.
Welcome! ...No, wait, that's not what they say around here.
You never talk back. Do you realise that?
So, what's new?
Speak, but be quick.
Back again, I see.
Yes, I'm listening already.
What is it this time?
Go ahead and talk, I'll keep picking.
Not so loud, the children are sleeping.
Go on. I've got a moment.
Always these interruptions.
Keep it short, yes?
What's the matter?
I'm not in that much of a hurry either.
Talk. I'm all ears.
I saw you coming from a mile away.
Well now, company at last.
Ohhrm.
Ehh-hm.
Brmm?
Uff-hm.
Hnngh.
Mrrh-mrr.
Ehrm-ehrm.
Hoff.
It's easy to get lost in here. Make it quick.
I'll hold my nose while we talk, if you don't mind.
Wet enough for you? What do you want?
Hard to hear between the trees. Closer, please.
In the middle of the flowers? Fine, I'm listening.
Careful, the blossoms will end up in your face.
Can it wait until I've finished sowing?
I'm reading. What is it?
Please don't disturb my prayers.
The anvil won't wait, but fine, I'm listening.
Are you here to trade or just to chat?
Ever notice how blocky everything really is around here?
My nose is a cube. I've gotten used to it.
Why is that mountain over there just a staircase? Don't ask me.
Round? What's round? Never heard of it.
Life finds a way. Heard that somewhere once.
I just want to keep farming, long and in peace.
Hey, wouldn't happen to have a piece of heart to spare, would you?
Who else is going to call the ghostbusters if this place is haunted?
My power level's over nine thousand today. I think.
Someday I'll be the greatest villager there ever was. Believe it!
Is this forest full of spirits? Then I'd rather stay inside.
Sometimes I cry secretly when things get sad. Is that bad?
Why do you always look up at me like that, anyway?
I heard somewhere there's a green version of us. Zombies. Creepy.
Sometimes I stand in the same spot for hours. I've noticed that too.
In this heat? Make it quick.
Watch out a panda doesn't step on your foot.
I don't want to stay down here long. Speak.
Let me get my feet in the sand first, then I'll talk.
These white trunks always make me sleepy. What is it?
These blossoms make you all sentimental. So, what's wrong?
This colour makes me nervous. Talk.
Too dark in here for me. Keep it brief.
Shh. Not so loud, or something will hear us.
Sand in every crack. What do you want?
Watch where you step. Now, what is it?
In the middle of a flower field? Fine, go on then.
At least these trees give some shade. What is it?
In this cold, I'll keep it short.
Cold here among the firs. Speak quickly.
Careful, that ice is sharp. So? What do you want?
Everything grows here faster than I can clear it.
It's always dripping in here. Just like your questions.
Wet feet, again. What is it?
So many flowers here, it makes talking easy.
At least it's quiet on this island. Was.
Salt water in my ears. Speak up.
These trees were here before I was born. And you?
It gets dizzying up here. Make it quick.
Nothing but open space here. And you're disturbing the peace.
The water's rushing, I can barely hear you.
In this dryness, I'd rather think than talk.
My toes are half frozen already. Make it quick.
I don't want to stand here long. Speak.
Nothing but pebbles here. And you.
It's always bubbling here. Just like you are right now.
It gets dark fast among the pines. Make it quick.
This colour is... something else. What is it?
The wind's blowing my words away. Louder, please.
These terracotta colours are almost as blinding as the sun.
My water warms up faster out here than I'd like.
These stalks grow faster than I can count them.
Don't knock too hard, or a stalk will land right on your head.
These pillars look like they could topple any moment.
Everything's black out here. Even my mood.
Sand between my toes, again.
The waves calm me down. You, less so.
These pale trunks almost look like a row of fences.
Autumn leaves or not, it's always somehow bright here.
Petals in my hair, constantly. Barely bothers me anymore.
So much pink here, you could almost forget autumn's coming.
These mushrooms here are bigger than I am.
I miss the green, if I'm honest.
Even at noon it's almost like night in here.
I hope there's no witch's hut nearby.
If something can hear us down here, I don't want to know what.
My voice shakes on its own down here. No idea why.
I can already feel sand grinding in my teeth.
You freeze at night and burn by day here. Wonderful, isn't it?
Every drip in here sounds like a clock.
Those spikes look like teeth. Creepy.
The bees here are louder than half the market callers.
I could pick a bouquet right here. For whoever, really.
Enough wood here for three new houses.
I can barely see the sky through these leaves.
My fingers have already gone numb out here.
The ice is cracking under me. Not reassuring.
It's even colder between the firs than usual.
The snow clings on stubbornly here, more than elsewhere.
One wrong step and you're stuck.
These ice spires are taller than our bell tower.
These vines grow faster than I can cut them back.
Somewhere up there a parrot is screeching. Constantly.
These berries practically glow.
That's moss, not a carpet, in case you were wondering.
These roots are like a maze.
I think I just touched something slimy.
The bees hum louder here than in any flower field.
I could almost take a nap right here.
These giant mushrooms cast more shade than most trees.
Pretty quiet out here. Almost eerily calm.
Too much salt water makes you thirsty, you know.
Something big is swimming down there. I'd rather not look too closely.
These trunks are so thick, three of us couldn't reach around one.
Up in the canopy here, I can barely see the light.
The village looks tiny from up here.
One gust of wind and I nearly went flying off.
No trees, no hills, just grass. Calming, somehow.
The horses out here run freer than I ever could.
The current's pretty strong here, careful.
A salmon just swam right past me. Cheeky.
These acacias barely give any shade, but better than nothing.
The ground's so dry here it crunches with every step.
I've lost my nose twice already. At least it feels that way.
The snow muffles every step. Almost eerily quiet.
Every step here takes twice the effort.
Those blue flames scare me more than fire itself.
Every step here is a potential stumble.
At least there's plenty of gravel here for building.
These frogs croak louder than the market crier.
My boots will never be properly clean again after this.
The ground here is soft, buried in pine needles.
A fox is sneaking around back there. Watching us.
These fungi practically glow on their own.
At least it's quiet here. Too quiet, actually.
The wind's about to carry my hat clean away.
Up here you can barely hear yourself think.
This portal doesn't sit right with me. Talk, but quick.
I'm not moving from this spot, no matter what you say.
That purple thing over there is crackling again. Unsettling.
Make it quick, this portal's got me on edge.
This place feels wrong. Speak quietly.
I'd rather not stare into that portal too long.
Whatever's waiting on the other side, I don't want to know.
This portal always gives me the shivers.
One moment, I'm trading with someone else right now.
Can't you see I'm busy? Wait a moment.
One thing at a time, yes? I'll be done shortly.
No cutting in while I'm trading.
Huh? What do you want from me? I'm still little.
Better ask the grown-ups. I don't know anything yet.
I'm not allowed to trade yet. At least that's what my mother says.
Hehe, that tickled!
Mmmh... not now... still sleeping...
Who's bothering me in the middle of the night?
...five more minutes...
Let me sleep. Please.
That bell just now gave me quite a scare.
The moment that bell rings, I run. Without even thinking.
Was that the bell? Or am I imagining it?
The bell! Inside, quick!
I heard the bell. We'll talk later.
Was that the bell just now? I need to go.
No time now, the bell rang.
The moment that bell rings, I run. Without even thinking.
The chopping block won't wait. What is it?
My hands are bloody, literally. Keep it short.
I'm drawing right now. Don't distract me, or the line goes crooked.
Maps don't lie. I just need more paper.
Shh, you'll scare off the fish.
Fishing needs quiet. You're the opposite of that.
I'm carving arrows right now. Wait a moment, yes?
Not so close, or I'll prick you by accident.
My hands are covered in tanning solution right now. What is it?
Leather waits for no one. So, quick.
The chisel won't wait. Speak.
I'm in the middle of a wall. Literally.
The sheep need me more than you do right now.
Quick, I need to get back to the flock.
Clear sky at last. I don't mind talking a bit longer for that.
No rain, no clouds - perfect day for a chat.
In this lovely weather? Sure, go ahead and ask.
In the middle of the night? Bold of you.
I should really be asleep. But fine, what is it?
Haven't even had my coffee yet. So, what's up?
Well, the day's off to a start, with you here already.
The sun's setting, and here you are. Fine, then.
I was just about to call it a day. Quickly, then.
Middle of the day, I've actually got things to do. But go on.
Best time for a chat, honestly.
At least give me time to open my eyes.
Five minutes and I'm gone. So make it quick.
Every word echoes down here. Speak quieter.
I'm counting the seconds till I'm out of here. Talk fast.
This place scares me. Please, make it quick.
Hit first, questions after? No thanks.
We'll always have this village. Whatever happens.
I feel like the king of the entire plains right now!
You want the truth? You can't handle it.
Village, we have a problem.
I see dead... well, undead people. Constantly. Comes with living here.
Fresh meat smells different than you'd think. And I smell everything.
My knife's sharper than my mood right now.
Not so close to the chopping block, yes? Accidents happen fast.
I count sausages, not people bothering me.
Smoke gets into my clothes. You get used to it.
Whoever wants meat waits. Whoever just wants to talk waits too.
Ink costs, paper costs, time costs. And you're costing me some right now too.
One crooked line ruins the whole map. So, quiet.
I draw borders I never cross myself.
My quill's steadier than my patience right now.
Every map has blank spots. Just like my knowledge of you.
Ask later. I'm in the middle of a river.
Fish aren't biting well today. Neither is my mood.
I've caught everything except what I actually wanted.
My bait costs more than the fish I catch with it. Ironic.
The water makes you patient. Or mad. For me, both.
Quiet by the shore is rare. You're making it rarer.
A good catch needs silence. You're the opposite of that.
Every feather counts. Don't waste it by distracting me.
A crooked arrow is a waste. Same as this chat, if you want nothing.
I need steady hands for straight shafts. So, stay still.
My workbench is covered in wood shavings. Same as my head right now.
I count my arrows more often than I'd like. Easy to lose track.
A bow without arrows is just a stick. Same as me without peace and quiet, just nerves.
I smell of tanning solution, but at least I sell something useful.
Raw hides become something valuable. Just takes time and strong nerves.
My workbench is covered in scraps. Nothing goes to waste here.
A good stitch outlasts most promises.
I'd rather hang leather than chat with you. Nothing personal.
Every piece needs its time to tan. Same as patience.
I chip stones into shape, not excuses.
A wall only holds if every stone sits right. Same as a village.
Dust in my lungs, muscle in my arms. Honest work.
I build faster than you can talk. Almost.
A crooked stone falls eventually. That's why I check twice.
Stone by stone, day by day. No need to rush.
My sheep don't run off. Not far, anyway.
Wool grows back. Patience, sadly, doesn't always.
I'd rather count sheep than excuses.
A sheared sheep always gives me that look. I know it well.
The flock needs guidance. Same as some conversations.
I smell of wool and fresh air. Could be worse.
Blue sky, warm air - what more could you want.
In weather like this, talking comes easier than usual.
Not a cloud in the sky. Almost suspiciously calm.
A day like this shouldn't be spent indoors. But well, here I am.
The sun feels good. So does a bit of company, honestly.
Clear weather, clear thoughts. Go ahead, ask whatever you like.
The stars are bright tonight. You're loud.
I can already hear the monsters from here. Make it quick.
Even a golem should be asleep at this hour.
Every sound gets twice as creepy at night.
I like the night. Just not when it keeps me awake.
Barely any light, and yet you still found me. Impressive.
The dew's still on the grass. Same as the sleep still on me.
Early bird catches the good neighbour reputation. Are you practising?
The birds are louder than you usually are. Quite the feat.
I'm only half awake. Don't expect too much.
A fresh morning, a fresh question? Sure, why not.
No coffee here, but company, sure. Does that work?
The shadows are getting long. Same as my day.
Bedtime's coming soon. But not quite yet.
The sky's turning orange. Nice moment for a chat.
I like the evening. Calmer than the day, louder than the night.
Last errands before dark. Make it quick.
The day's winding down, but I've got a moment still.
Full sun, full schedule. But fine, what is it?
Right in the middle of work, but I'm still listening.
The day's long enough for a quick chat.
Best visibility, best time to find me.
I'm already sweating in this sun. Make it quick.
I'm more patient during the day than at night. Use the chance.
My eyes are barely open. Speak slowly.
Awake this early? Respect. Or madness.
My thoughts are still in bed. The rest of me's already here.
Morning hasn't quite caught up with me yet.
Give me a moment. Just one.
Barely up, and already chaos. Classic.
My bed is calling. Louder than you right now.
I'm about to turn in. So, what's this about?
The sun's going, and so am I, soon.
Last question before bed, yes?
I'm already half in my nightshirt. In my head, at least.
Just a bit longer, then I'm off duty.
I can barely see my hand in front of my face down here. Who even are you?
The air's stuffy in here. Make it quick.
I'm not fond of caves. Too many corners, not enough light.
Every sound down here makes me nervous.
What are you even looking for down here? Besides bothering me.
Some torches wouldn't hurt in here. But fine, speak.
The heat here is unbearable. Keep it short.
I don't want to stay here longer than I have to.
This place scares me. But fine, what is it?
Lava everywhere. I'd rather watch my step.
Even the air feels wrong here.
Get me out of here, then we'll talk properly.
This place is so quiet it scares me.
I see those flying creatures and just want to leave.
Nothing here feels normal. Please, make it quick.
The ground here practically floats. Same as my stomach.
I miss solid ground beneath me. The real kind.
Take me back, and I'll tell you everything.
Ouch. Was that necessary?
I'm still bleeding, and you want to talk?
Hit first, ask questions later - I don't care for that.
That hurt. More than you'd think.
Give me a moment before you keep talking.
I'm not a target for practice, in case that wasn't clear.
I hope you believe in the Heart of the Sea. I certainly do.
Lightsabers are sold out, unfortunately.
Off the clock, I'm actually a vegetarian.
I once planted a field of beans. No miracle grew, but the soup was good.
I own a book that supposedly knows every spell in the world. Mostly it just explains the library rules.
I once dreamed of a giant white whale. All I woke up with was a wet bed.
I don't brew potions that turn people into cats. That happened exactly once, and I'd rather not discuss it.
I once tried building a wall to keep the winter out. Winter came anyway.
I always watch for wolves in sheep's clothing. Around here, they're usually just wolves.
Some say I never miss a shot. Not entirely true, but I let them believe it.
I once built an iron suit that was supposedly going to fly. It didn't.
I once made a ring an offer it couldn't refuse. It refused anyway.
I once forged an axe that was supposed to fell any tree in one blow. So far it's only hit my thumb.
